in_hebrew.name: טבורציה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: טבורציה (Tiburcia) היא שם עברי שמקורו ברומאיה. הפירוש: 'אלהים-רחמן' (אלוהים הרחום). שם זה קשור לדמותה של קדושה רומאית-נוצרית. לא קיים ציון ספרי ברית הישנה לשם זה. השם יכול ליצור קשרים עם רחמנות, חסד, ואמונה.

in_greek.name: Θιβουρσία
in_greek.long_meaning: Θιβουρσία (Tiburcia) είναι ελληνικό όνομα από τη ρωμαϊκή προέλευση. Η σημασία είναι 'Ελεητής θεός', αλλιώς 'Ελεήμων θεός'. Δεν υπάρχει αναφορά στο Παλαιό Διατάγματα. Το όνομα μπορεί να σχετίζεται με την ιδέα του θεού που είναι πλούσιος σε χάρις, ελεημοσύνη και θρησκευτική πίστη.

in_latin.name: Tiburcia
in_latin.long_meaning: Tiburcia est nomen Latinum a Romanis oriundum. Significatio: 'Deus misericors', id est 'Deus misericors'. Non est in Veteri Testamento. Nomen potest esse in connexione cum divinitas misericordia, pietas, et fides.

data.cultural_impact: Tiburcia is a Christian name rooted in both Roman and religious history. The name originated from the ancient Roman family name Tiberius, which holds significance as a masculine name referring to the Tiber River in Italy. However, in Christian tradition, the name has been adopted as that of Saint Tiburcia, a young martyr who was reportedly beheaded for her faith under Emperor Diocletian. The name Tiburcia thus carries a rich cultural heritage, blending Roman antiquity with the legacy of early Christian martyrs.
data.spiritual_significance: The Christian name Tiburcia holds deep spiritual significance as it embodies the valor and steadfastness of a martyr. The name honors Saint Tiburcia, a brave young woman who gave her life in the name of her faith. As a result, the name represents the inherent strength and courage that transcends worldly matters, inspiring those who bear it to live their lives with unwavering dedication and conviction towards their beliefs. Saint Tiburcia stands as a symbol of devotion, sacrifice, and unyielding resilience, encouraging those who carry her name to face their struggles with fortitude and faith.
